objective: Aislar PK/UNIQUE de candidatos canonicos de unidad/sucursal para RRR.

queries.name: unit_pk_unique
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name IN ('Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad','Sistema_HorariosServicioUnidad','Sistema_SyncPOS_EstadoUnidad','Sync_KPI_Ventas_Unidades','Sistema_UnidadesNegocioPerfilDigital') AND i.is_hypothetical=0 ORDER BY t.name,i.is_primary_key DESC,i.is_unique DESC,i.name,ic.key_ordinal
